voyage.name: Basilica of Saint Nicholas
voyage.content: This romanic church with a gold ceiling and a crypt contains many medieval attractions, including the magnificent cathedra of Bishop Elias.

voyage.name: Bari Cathedral
voyage.content: A Roman church even older than St. Nicolas', though later refurbished in baroque style, and equally interesting.

voyage.name: Castello normanno-svevo
voyage.content: The symbolic fortress of the city: built in the 12th century, destroyed and then rebuilt during the 13th century by Frederick II.

voyage.name: Chiesa di Sant’Anna
voyage.content: St. Anna Church was built between 1246-1247 as a synagogue, known as “Scola Grande”. It was later converted into a Christian Church and entrusted to the Confraternity of St. Anna. Finally, in 2009, the Church became a museum.Its history is rooted to ancient times, when there was a significant Jewish community in Apulia, mostly composed of traders and farmers. During the early Middle Ages, the Jewish culture experienc

voyage.name: Church of Santa Chiara
voyage.content: Built on the site of the medieval Santa Maria degli Alemanni church, this site was acquired by the Order of Saint Clare in 1429. After various renovations in the 16th century, the church was completely rebuilt in its current Baroque style during the early 18th century.

voyage.name: Teatro Petruzzelli
voyage.content: The largest theatre of the city and the fourth Italian theatre by size. Its season feature high quality productions of prose, opera, ballet and classical music.

voyage.name: Festa di San Nicola Patrono di Bari
voyage.content: The Saint of the city is Saint Nicholas. He is celebrated by the Catholic Church on December 6. In Bari, several masses take place early in the morning (as early as 04:00) of December 6. A huge crowd and lots of fast food stands fill the old town through the night. The city's main celebration of Saint Nicholas, however, takes place in May 6–8 with historical reconstructions, popular music and a two-day fireworks cont

voyage.name: Fiera del Levante
voyage.content: Hosted yearly during September, the Fiera del Levante is no longer just an exhibition, where you can also find stands for many countries in the world, but now also a place for hosting conferences and musical events.

voyage.name: Bari International Film Festival
voyage.content: It is an annual film festival held since 2009.

voyage.content: Cosy Rox are a couple of residences operated for overnight stays and short term rentals. To stay you will need to visit the main hostel (Sumas Bla hostel) at 40 Piazza Luigi di Savoia, from where you will be directed to the place where you will stay. voyage.name: Savoia International lt Bari Stazione
voyage.address: Piazza Luigi di Savoia Duca Degli Abruzzi, 24
voyage.content: This B&B has a great location. Near the accommodation there are some popular points of interest like Ferrarese Square, Mercantile Square, Bari Port.

voyage.name: B&B Cavour 124
voyage.address: Corso Camillo Benso Conte di Cavour, 124
voyage.content: This B&B is really close to Bari Cathedral and the centre of Bari is 1 km away from the venue.

voyage.name: Room 110 Bari
voyage.content: Room 110 is set next to the centre of Bari. It is really close to Ferrarese Square.

voyage.name: Hotel Boston
voyage.content: One block from Corso Vittorio Emanuele II, ten minutes to the old town. Rooms are spacious but fairly basic. Generous breakfast. There is a small supermarket across the street. €90 for a double.

voyage.name: Hotel Adria
voyage.content: 70 m from Corso Cavour. Also the historic centre and St Nicholas Cathedral are very close to the Hotel.

voyage.name: Hotel Cristal
voyage.content: A 5-minute walk from the centre of Bari.

voyage.name: B&B ApuliaBlue Apartments
voyage.content: B&B and apartments with on-site parking and Wi-Fi. Facilities include a rooftop terrace, garden, and bar. Airport shuttle and bike rentals are available. Rooms are air conditioned and soundproofed.

voyage.name: Hotel Terranobile Meta Resort
voyage.content: Spa resort a few kilometres from downtown, with wellness centre and swimming pools.

voyage.name: Hotel Oriente Bari
voyage.content: Four-star accommodation behind the famous Petruzzelli Theatre, in the city centre, a few blocks away from the sea line; with 75 bedrooms divided into double classic, deluxe and suites, and with large public areas, internet connection, meeting and ballrooms and a panoramic terrace. Also available for weddings and special occasions.

voyage.name: The Nicolaus Hotel Bari
voyage.content: 3.7 km from the historic centre of Bari. Some rooms have a great view of the city.

voyage.name: Palace Hotel Bari
voyage.content: 1 km from the centre of Bari and 0.6 km from Basilica of Saint Nicholas.

voyage.name: iH Grande Albergo Delle Nazioni
voyage.content: 1.6 km from Port of Bari; the centre of Bari is 2 km away.

voyage.name: Parco dei principi Hotel&SPA
voyage.address: Via vito Vasie, prolungamento viale europa 6
voyage.content: 4-star hotel, 1.5 km from Karol Wojtyla Airport, offers free parking and free WI-FI connection and conference spaces with 10 soundproofed meeting rooms on the ground and 1st floors.
